The issuer shows very strong balance-sheet strength, with equity covering about 48% of assets and retained earnings that are exceptionally large relative to the asset base, alongside solid operating profitability (EBIT margin around 13%). Liquidity is only moderate at a 1.18 current ratio, but overall the figures support a high-grade, low-credit-risk profile consistent with the low-AA range.

DECISION: AA
